title: Blender-Agent OBJ/MTL export evidence at v0.0.2.1

features.label: Publish the OBJ and MTL and preserve the assigned color

documented_in.anchor: OBJ exports publish the matching MTL beside the OBJ and return its path in `material_library`. Keep both files together when moving the asset. External texture images remain separate. MCP and default CLI calls protect both destination names. Explicit CLI `--overwrite` applies to both output files while protecting the source model and its material libraries.
